findings.message: The page says commits log time, but they don't. `HERO_LEDE` says "Commits close tasks and log time", `DESCRIPTION` says "Agents log time", and the captions (`amax-product.en.vtt` 00:09–00:15: "And logs the time for the person it acted for. Wednesday goes from 5.0 to 7.5 hours") show hours landing on the timesheet with nobody acting. What ships is different. `modules/time/suggestions.ts` `commitTimeHandler` turns a commit's hours into a `time.commit-draft` suggestion, and only the person's acceptance logs a draft entry ("Only the person accepting it logs the entry"). The architecture's agent rule (006) says the same: an agent's output is a suggestion. The page therefore claims an automatic write that the product refuses to make, which also contradicts its own "Agents record, people decide" framing. Fix: say commits suggest time that the person accepts (for example "Commits close tasks and draft your time"), make the video caption show the accept step, and add the hero, description and VTT text to a test that rejects 'log(s) time' unless it is tied to accepting.
findings.scenario: Kasun pushes a commit naming 2.5 h → no time.entry is written, only a pending suggestion on Kasun's Suggestions screen → the hero and video tell prospects the 2.5 h was already logged.

findings.message: Both copy guards check only part of the visible copy. The Coming-feature check here and the chat-only confirm check in marketing-confirm.test.ts cover the hero, the description, How it works, the live claims and (for confirms) the mock. Copy written inline elsewhere is never checked: `Trust.tsx` POINTS, `Problem.tsx`, `ChatPreview.tsx` TURNS, the `ProductVideo.tsx` figcaption and `amax-product.en.vtt`. A Coming word or an unscoped confirm claim added to any of them passes both tests. The VTT already contains 'invoice', a Coming word under `finance`. Fix: move that copy into copy.ts, or import it into both prose tables.
findings.scenario: Add "Billing-ready audit trail" to Trust POINTS → both tests stay green even though billing is Coming.

findings.message: If the mock's `data-change="062-marketing-site"` section is missing or renamed, `indexOf` returns -1, `slice(-1, n)` returns an empty string, and the 'mock 062 section' case passes on no text at all. Fix: assert the section was found and is non-empty before checking it.
findings.scenario: The mock section is renamed to data-change="062-marketing" → section is "" → the test passes with nothing checked.

findings.message: The mock and the code describe the video differently. The mock's 062 section says the video runs 40 s ('Product video, 40 seconds', a 0–40 s storyboard ending with a release move), but `ProductVideo.tsx` and the VTT run 35 s. The mock also shows 'Book a demo' unconditionally and labels the chat card 'Live preview', while the code hides the demo link when AMAX_SALES_EMAIL is unset and says 'Preview'. Separately, the section is inserted under the `<!-- 047 Admin end to end -->` comment, so that header now labels the 062 section. Fix: correct the mock in its own small change, as the module standard requires.

robots.ts and sitemap.ts both carry the comment 'AMAX_SALES_EMAIL and AMAX_BASE_URL are runtime settings', copied from the welcome page. Neither file reads AMAX_SALES_EMAIL; they depend only on the origin. Fix: drop AMAX_SALES_EMAIL from both comments.

The matcher exception `marketing/` sends every `/marketing/...` path past the proxy, so those paths skip the session gate and the page rate limit. Today only static files live there, but a route added under /marketing later would be served to signed-out visitors without a gate. Fix: limit the exception to the asset extensions under /marketing (mp4, webm, vtt, jpg).
findings.scenario: A future app/(app)/marketing/page.tsx requested at /marketing/x → the proxy never runs → no redirect to /signin and no rate limit.

findings.message: The mock and the shipped video disagree on the product video. The mock's 062 section says the video is 40 seconds ("Product video, 40 seconds") and its storyboard runs to 40 s, ending with a release moving UAT → Prod at 26–34 s and an end card at 34–40 s. The shipped captions (amax-product.en.vtt) end at 35 s, and the video's aria-label says 35 seconds. Change the mock's figure label and storyboard to the shipped 35 s timeline, so the mock and the code describe the same asset.
findings.scenario: Compare the mock 062 section with /welcome: the mock says 40 s, the page and captions say 35 s.
